description: A northbound box truck moving through the center of the intersection passes just in front of an eastbound two-wheeler crossing the intersection, the two-wheeler reaches the truck's path less than 1.5s later.
A white sedan maneuvering in the center of the intersection passes very close to a two-wheeler traveling through the center, with the two-wheeler passing through the sedan's path within 1.5s.
A southbound vehicle turning left toward the east and a crossing vehicle meet in the center of the intersection, passing within about a car length of each other.
A white car traveling west in the eastbound lanes has a head-on encounter with an eastbound car traveling east, passing within less than 1.5 seconds of colliding.

White vehicle traveling east then turning south through center of intersection cuts across path of northbound two_wheeler, passing through same point less than 1.5s ahead with lateral clearance of less than a car length.
Southbound white vehicle from the north approach passes through the center just ahead of a west to north left-turning dark vehicle, the turning vehicle reaches the same point less than 1.5s later.
Southbound white vehicle continues south through the intersection passing just in front of the queue of west to north left-turning white vehicles in the center.
Left-turning white box truck from the west approach cuts across the southbound lane, a following southbound white vehicle passes just ahead/behind it with less than 1.5s separation.

Southbound vehicle traveling through the center of the intersection passes through a conflict point that an east-to-west crossing two-wheeler reaches less than 1.5 seconds later, with minimum separation at the center of the intersection.

Northbound blue vehicle proceeding straight through the center conflicts with a southbound white vehicle turning left from the north approach, the turning vehicle passes just ahead of the through vehicle.
Westbound white vehicle from the east approach passes through the central conflict point less than 1.5 seconds ahead of a northbound two_wheeler crossing the intersection.
southbound cars turning west pass very close in front of the eastbound bus in the center of the intersection
Southbound car/bus passes just in front of a two-wheeler crossing the centre of the intersection from east to west, the two-wheeler reaches the vehicle's path less than 1.5s later.
Same southbound bus continues and narrowly misses a second following two-wheeler crossing the centre, passing within less than 1.5s of colliding.

An eastbound vehicle in the southern carriageway proceeds east while a northbound two-wheeler from the south side crosses the eastbound lanes, the car passes through the two-wheeler's path less than 1.5s before the two-wheeler arrives.

A vehicle turning left from the north approach to go east cuts across the center of the intersection in front of a vehicle turning from the east approach to go south, both pass through the same central conflict point within about 1s.
white car turning in center of intersection and black car crossing pass within a car length of each other

A southbound vehicle traveling through the center of the intersection and a northbound vehicle entering from the south approach head-on in conflicting paths and pass each other with very small clearance.

Eastbound white vehicle crossing the intersection from the west conflicts with the southbound platoon released from the north; the southbound lead vehicle passes through the crossing point less than 1.5s after the eastbound vehicle.

Northbound bus approaching the southern crosswalk from the south conflicts with pedestrians crossing west from the southeast island; the bus reaches the crosswalk point less than 1.5s after pedestrians occupy it.
Southbound white vehicle proceeding straight through the center passes through the same point less than 1.5s ahead of an eastbound two-wheeler crossing the middle of the intersection.
Southbound through vehicle and a crossing blue turning vehicle converge in the middle of the intersection and pass with less than 1.5s gap.
A southbound vehicle turning right from the north approach to go east cuts across the path of an eastbound two-wheeler crossing the intersection, passing just in front of it with less than 1.5s gap.

Eastbound box truck in the center of the intersection passes through the crossing point of a north to south crossing two-wheeler waiting/moving in the middle of the eastbound lanes, the two-wheeler reaches the truck's path less than 1.5s after the truck.
Second eastbound van following the box truck passes through the same central point just before/after the same crossing two-wheeler, with less than 1.5s separation.

A white car turning left across the center of the intersection passes very closely in front of a through vehicle traveling east, the through vehicle reaches the same conflict point less than 1.5 seconds after the turning car.
Eastbound vehicle crossing from west passes through the path of a northbound turning vehicle in the center of the intersection with less than 1.5s gap.
South-east bound vehicle in the center-east of the intersection passes close to a southbound two_wheeler on the eastern crosswalk area with less than 1.5s gap.

A white car traveling west from the east and turning left to go south merges into the southbound lane directly in front of a white car traveling south from the north, passing through the merge point less than 1.5 seconds ahead of the southbound car.
Southbound vehicle through central intersection passes just in front of a crossing two-wheeler moving west, with less than 1.5s separation at the crossing point.

A southbound vehicle from the north approach proceeding through the center of the intersection passes through the path of an eastbound two-wheeler crossing the intersection, the two passing within about one second of each other.

A southbound vehicle in the center of the intersection and a northwest-bound vehicle coming from the east approach cross the same point with less than 1.5s separation, passing within a few meters of each other.
A southbound bus turning toward the east and a westbound vehicle from the east approach pass in front of each other in the center-southeast of the intersection with less than 1.5s separation.
Southbound white van turning left from the westbound approach cuts south across the eastbound through lanes passing just in front of an eastbound silver car
White sedan driving southwest through center of intersection cuts across path of eastbound dark sedan, passing just ahead of it

Eastbound white car follows a large vehicle through the northeast right-turn from east to north, passing through the same turn point less than 1.5s after the lead vehicle with converging paths at closest approach.
northbound teal truck and southbound red truck pass each other closely in the center of the intersection
Northbound white vehicle proceeds through intersection while an eastbound two_wheeler crosses its path from east to west, passing through the same point less than 1.5 seconds ahead of the vehicle
Westbound silver vehicle crosses the intersection while a two_wheeler traveling north cuts across its lane, the vehicle passing just in front of the two_wheeler
white vehicle from north turning west and white vehicle traveling south cross the same central point with less than 1.5s separation
North-to-south white car passes just behind the left-turning semi-trailer turning from north to east, crossing the trailer's swept path less than 1.5s after it clears.
Following north-to-south red car passes just behind the same left-turning semi-trailer with under 1.5s gap as the trailer exits east.
Eastbound white vehicle passes through the south crosswalk point just under 1.5s after / before a group of northbound two_wheelers cross the eastbound lanes
